summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 62 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Buys Streaming Show ‘TBPN,’ Aiming to Change Narrative on A.I.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Adversaries Exploit Vacant Homes to Intercept Mail in Hybrid Cybercrime
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 45 articles published in the last 24 hours
